name: Zajchik: Poka ty ryadom
source:
It's easy to lose track in the snow, but impossible to hide the truth.
This is the story of Katya and Polina, where a warm friendship gradually intertwines with secrets best left undisclosed.

Experience this story from Ekaterina Smirnova's perspective.
Is all well and good in this warm friendship?
